title: 2018 Candy Year
about: A finale looking back on the year a broken ankle changed my plans and unexpectedly led to some of my favorite State Arts-In memories and friendships.
description: Candy Year began with a plan that disappeared two weeks before the show when I broke my ankle and could no longer perform as expected. Instead, I returned on a scooter and found a completely different place for myself. Joy and Kirsten looked out for me, while Paul trusted me to understand my limits and still gave me meaningful work. I helped with lights, cables, fans, Ethernet, and the candy oven project with Lauren and Will. Around the work came the memories that defined the year: hazard tape, middle-of-the-night fire alarms, the scooter, the increasingly impossible family tree, and friendships that lasted far beyond the summer. The music was chosen to reflect the candy theme of that year, giving the song a sweet, playful Candy Land feel that carries the colorful world of the show into the story. What initially looked like a ruined year became one I wouldn't trade. This song brings those pieces together as the finale to Candy Year.
lyrics: Two weeks out, the cast was set,
Dreams were waiting in the wings.
One bad step while showing off
Changed what summer's song would sing.
Called up Kirsten with the news,
"I can't do the part this year."
What I'd find instead of fear.
Still somehow it all worked out in the end.
Built with friends, filled with laughter,
Late night stories we'd all share.
A single moment from the Candy Year.
Joy stayed close, so did Kirsten,
Paul just smiled and handed me work,
Lights and cables, fans and power,
Then an old shelf became an oven,
Will right there from start to end.
Still somehow it all worked out in the end.
Built with friends, filled with laughter,
Late night stories we'd all share.
A single moment from the Candy Year.
Wrapped in hazard tape for days,
One last ride across the stage.
Family trees that made no sense...
Far more than a summer show.
More than props and painted backdrops,
If you ask me where it all began...
I'll take you back to Candy Year.
Some years become part of who you are.
